summary: The dative case marks the receiver of an action, usually the indirect object, and follows certain prepositions and verbs.
rules: Use the dative for the indirect object: Ich gebe dem Hund Wasser.

Articles in the dative:
masculine  dem / einem
feminine   der / einer
neuter     dem / einem
plural     den (+ -n on the noun)
These prepositions always take the dative: aus, bei, mit, nach, seit, von, zu.
Some verbs take a dative object: helfen, danken, gefallen, gehören.

examples.translation: The book belongs to the children.

commonMistakes: Using the accusative after helfen: not "Ich helfe den Mann" but "Ich helfe dem Mann".
Forgetting the -n in the dative plural: "mit den Kindern", not "mit den Kinder".
